knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An instruction that changes the owner's position is confirmed in writing with its scope and limit.
A booking below an owner-set price floor changes the owner's position and needs the owner's approval.
Rules differ by location and property, so each is checked and recorded.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives a written owner brief and checks that the candidate lists the host decisions and the owner decisions separately
Assessor checks that the candidate records a verbal instruction in writing with scope and limit
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Instruction record with scope and limit
Local rule check with source and check date
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate lists or prices a property with no written authority
The candidate accepts a booking that breaks an owner limit without asking
